findings.title: Lithuanian loginTotpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The HTML-bearing Lithuanian string was replaced with "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:", which is Italian. Lithuanian users now see an Italian sentence on the OTP setup page. Use a Lithuanian translation of "Install one of the following applications on your mobile:", or drop the key so it falls back to English.

findings.title: Lithuanian account totpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: totpStep1 in the Lithuanian account theme was replaced with the Italian sentence "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:". The neighbouring Lithuanian lines are untouched, so the page mixes languages. Provide a proper Lithuanian translation or remove the key so it falls back to English.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese locale given Traditional Chinese text
findings.body: totpStep1 in messages_zh_CN now reads "在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：", which is Traditional Chinese (手機, 安裝, 應用程式). The rest of the file is Simplified Chinese, so zh_CN users see the wrong script. Use Simplified wording such as "在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一：".

findings.title: JS-app bundle switched from i18next {{n}} placeholders to {n}
findings.body: This key was changed from `{{0}}`/`{{1}}`/`{{2}}` to `{0}`/`{1}`/`{2}` plus a Java `choice` format. Every other error-* key in the same file still uses i18next `{{n}}` interpolation, and i18next does not understand `{2,choice,...}`. If the UI renders this key client-side, it will show the literal placeholders and choice pattern instead of the values. The same change was made in the admin-ui bundle. Keep the i18next form for these JS bundles, or confirm the message is only ever formatted server-side.

findings.title: Admin UI bundle error-invalid-multivalued-size no longer uses i18next interpolation
findings.body: The admin-ui bundle is rendered by i18next, which uses `{{0}}` placeholders, but this key now uses `{0}` and a Java `{2,choice,...}` expression. i18next will leave these unresolved, so the message shows raw placeholders and the choice syntax. Either keep i18next-compatible placeholders here or make sure the message is only formatted server-side.
